mentions.name: Veda Home
mentions.description: A wellness product that lets family members know how a distant loved one is doing without that person feeling monitored or pried on, focused on remote well-being check-ins.
mentions.problem: The author's mother had a stroke and he does not live close by; he could not find a wellness product that would tell him how she is doing without making her feel he is prying.
mentions.audience: Family members who want to keep informed about a distant relative's well-being, such as the author checking on his mother after her stroke
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on https://getvedahome.com

My mother had a stroke a little over a month ago and I don’t live close by. I went in search of a wellness product that would let me know how she’s doing without her feeling I’m prying too much. I didn’t find one, so now I’m trying to build it.
